rows.note: Use this specifically for someone whose job is fighting fires.

example.english: That fighter on the fire crew rescued the people trapped inside the blaze.
example.traditional: 嗰個消防員救咗困喺火場入面嘅人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 siu1 fong4 jyun4 gau3 zo2 kwan3 hai2 fo2 coeng4 jap6 min6 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a competitor in boxing or another combat sport or martial art.

example.english: This fighter will compete in a boxing match next month.
example.traditional: 呢位格鬥選手下個月會參加拳賽。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 gaak3 dau3 syun2 sau2 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 caam1 gaa1 kyun4 coi3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person engaged in fighting, especially in combat or for a cause.

example.english: This fighter held his ground on the front line to protect the villagers.
example.traditional: 呢位戰士喺前線為咗保護村民，堅持到最後。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 zin3 si6 hai2 cin4 sin3 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 cyun1 man4 gin1 ci4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6

rows.note: Use this for a competitive person who strongly wants to win and may be pugnacious.

example.english: They are such a competitive fighter that they cannot stand losing even one round.
example.traditional: 佢係好勝嘅人，輸咗一局都唔服氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 hou2 sing3 ge3 jan4 syu1 zo2 jat1 guk6 dou1 m4 fuk6 hei3
